title: SE Requirements Output Schema
description: Structured output schema for the se-requirements agent. Defines stakeholder requirements with arch-impact flags for role boundary enforcement per ISO/IEC 15288. Carries the REQ frontmatter vocabulary (Issue #339 B2): enum-typed status fields, ADR links and review iteration tracking.

rationale.description: Stakeholder need this requirement traces back to.

arch_impact.description: Whether this requirement implies architectural decisions that must be made by se-architect. Default: false.

arch_trigger.description: Why architecture is affected. Never a solution, always a problem statement. Only present when arch_impact is true.

acceptance_criteria.description: Measurable criteria against which the architect's chosen solution can later be validated.

scope.description: Classification for pipeline routing. system = needs full decomposition, component = refinement-level, both = both levels affected. Default: system.

decomposition_status.description: Whether further decomposition is expected downstream.

implementation_state.description: Implementation status of this requirement. Default: not_implemented.

test_status.description: Test coverage status of this requirement. Default: missing.

review_state.description: Review lifecycle status of this requirement. Default: open.

open_adrs.description: ADR-IDs that affect this requirement and are not yet accepted (Issue #339 B1/B6). Empty by default.

review_iteration.description: Monotonically increasing review iteration counter. Default: 0.

suspect_children.description: REQ-IDs of dependent requirements whose findings marked this requirement as suspect (bottom-up re-derivation, Issue #339 B6). Empty by default.

document_frontmatter.description: Mandatory YAML frontmatter block for the persisted REQ document (Issue #339 B2/B3). Strict: no free-text fields, no legacy fields (Implementation State, Review Findings, Test Status, Remarks).

req_id.description: Requirement ID of the document (e.g., REQ-L1-007).

scope.description: Scope identifier: project or subscope (system/component folder name).

author_agent.description: Agent that authored this document (e.g., se-requirements).

implementation_state.description: Enum: not_implemented | partially_implemented | implemented. Default: not_implemented.

test_status.description: Enum: missing | partial | covered. Default: missing.

review_state.description: Enum: open | reviewed | approved. Default: open.

open_adrs.description: ADR-IDs affecting this REQ that are not yet accepted.

last_reviewed.description: Date of the last review, ISO-8601. Null when never reviewed.

reviewer.description: Agent that performed the last review (e.g., se-critic, se-housekeeper). Null when never reviewed.

review_iteration.description: Monotonically increasing review iteration counter. Default: 0.

suspect_children.description: REQ-IDs of dependent requirements whose findings marked this REQ as suspect (bottom-up re-derivation, Issue #339 B6).

reviewState.description: Review state enum (Issue #339 B2). Separate lifecycle from implementation_state.
